messages.author: b32917c55cccfda7
messages.subject: Time Stratified Analysis
parts:
Hi Nick, 

  I am running a time stratified analysis with dispersal not allowed into an area until more recently than 25 mya. The tree that I am using has a single extant species in this area, and, this species is separated from its closest relatives by a long branch, with the ancestor existing ~45 mya. Therefore, I expected that the ancestor will be reconstructed as inhabiting one region, with dispersal to the terminal region occurring at some point along the branch. 

However, the results of the analysis suggest that the common ancestor is widespread across two regions, including the region that is prohibited 25 mya. I am assuming that I am setting up the time stratified analysis incorrectly, but I am not sure how to fix it. I am attaching my timeperiods and dispersal multipliers here and am hoping you could take a look at them. 

The disallowed area before 25 mya is "W" in the file.

Thanks!

--Elyse

messages.author: b32917c55cccfda7
messages.subject: Re: Time Stratified Analysis
parts:
Hi Nick, 

  I solved the problem by adding in an area allowed file! This also changed which model was selected as the best-fit for my data.

Thanks!

--Elyse
